purpose: Offline correction drafts; not permission to train or adopt a model
vocabulary: Frozen 601 raw Open Images outputs / 597 canonical FrameTrail categories
extent: Tight rectangle around the visible identifiable object, clipped to the photograph; never invent hidden extent. Boundary convention must be reconciled with publisher amodal boxes before a training release.
coverage: Inspect the whole image for identifiable in-vocabulary instances, including supported parts and garments. The 52 sampling anchors are not the label vocabulary. Unknown or unresolvable targets create a hold, not a verified negative.
hierarchy: Prefer the most specific defensible label. Do not invent ancestor boxes. Keep publisher parent/child records as pending until reviewed. Distinct supported parts are distinct instances; keys, shadows and logos are not automatically objects. Hierarchy supervision remains a training-release decision.
person_aliases: Use raw Person for new generic person boxes; do not infer age or gender. Existing Boy/Girl/Man/Woman aliases require same-instance deduplication review, not universal suppression.
special_cases: Crowds/group-of, depictions, reflections, tiny ambiguous objects and unknown inside flags require explicit review/hold handling. No ignore-aware loss or partial-label training is implemented here.
approval: Audit agreement is not box-completeness, rights, split or training approval. All exports from this module are DRAFT and have approved_for_training=false. No training data.yaml or dataset lock is produced.
